property_summary: Only calls to setL1BlockValues made from the depositorAccount address succeed (non-depositor callers always revert).
change_summary: Change the require check to compare msg.sender against the public variable depositorAccount (existing) but with inverted logic to allow anyone except the depositor to call — i.e., require(msg.sender != depositorAccount, ...). This alters who can set state so observable post-call state differs.
